transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we prepare to finalize the delivery package for the Harbor Film Festival premiere, I'd like to kick off the routine rights and technical signoff round. Before I give my final approval, I need the clearance counsel to flag any rights constraints and the post-production supervisor to report any technical delivery requirements or changes. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights constraint. I confirmed with the publisher this morning that the signed license for 'Blue Hour' permits only the in-person festival screening and prohibits a livestream. Additionally, the license requires the exact credit line: "Song 'Blue Hour' written by Nia Cole, published by Northstar Music." I haven't entered this confirmation in the delivery tracker yet because the publisher's email is still being attached to the clearance file, but the constraints are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a technical delivery constraint. My venue ingest test confirmed yesterday that Harbor Film Festival accepts this title only as a 5.1 discrete DCP mastered at 24 fps. The current stereo audio master in our delivery draft will be rejected. I have the test report in the post-production technical folder but haven't sent it to Mara yet because it's awaiting the final export log, so this is my formal report during the signoff round.
transcript.speaker: A3
